Fresh. Defined. Hydrated. Nourished.
A lightweight leave-in cream that refreshes your hair with deep hydration and rich nourishment. It smooths frizz and enhances your natural shape, leaving every strand soft, more defined, and full of life — whether curly, wavy, or straight.

products.name: Miracle Mask
products.shortDescription:
Intense Deep Hydration
A rich blend of Shea, Mango, and Cocoa butters with honey penetrates deeply to saturate dry hair with moisture. Restores softness, elasticity, and shine for deeply hydrated, silky, revitalized hair. Results visible from the very first use.
products.howToUse:
Apply generously to wet hair and leave on for 15 minutes before your shower, then shampoo and rinse as usual.
Alternatively, use it during your shower after shampoo and conditioner — apply to wet hair, leave for 15 minutes, and do not rinse completely to allow the mask to continue delivering deep hydration throughout the day.
products.ingredients: Biotin, Shea Butter, Mango Butter, Black Castor Oil, Argan Oil, Protein, Tamanu Butter, Kokum Butter, Aloe Vera, Honey, Avocado Oil, Omega 9, Pro-Vitamin B5 (Panthenol), Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate.

products.name: Heat Protectant
products.shortDescription:
Shield and Protect Your Hair All Day
Protect your hair with an invisible shield that defends against heat up to 450°F, UV rays, chlorine, and sun exposure. This powerful formula locks in moisture and shine, keeping your hair healthy, strong, and beautifully styled every day.
products.howToUse: Shake well before each use. Spray evenly onto damp or dry hair, focusing on areas most exposed to heat or sun. Comb through to distribute. Reapply every 2 hours when exposed to direct sunlight for optimal protection.
products.ingredients: Water, Organic Aloe Vera Juice, Organic Argan Oil, Coconut Oil, Organic Glycerin, Organic Jojoba Oil, Organic Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Pro-Vitamin B5, Green Tea Extract, Natural Vitamin E, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate (Natural Preservative)

products.name: Edge Control Wax Stick
products.shortDescription:
Tames Flyaways. Nourishes While It Holds.
This smooth-glide wax stick is infused with honey and coconut oil to nourish your hair while providing long-lasting hold. Perfect for taming baby hairs, smoothing edges, and keeping styles sleek without flaking or buildup. Lightweight, non-greasy, and easy to apply
products.howToUse: Apply directly to dry hair along the hairline or on flyaways. Use your fingers or a small brush to smooth hair into place. Ideal for sleek buns, ponytails, and polished styles.
products.ingredients: Beeswax, Almond Oil, Coconut Oil.

products.name: Crystal Glow Hair Serum
products.shortDescription:
Illuminate Your Hair with Radiant Golden Glow
Unlock dazzling shine and smoothness with our Crystal Glow Hair Serum, enriched with provitamins and peptides. This lightweight formula reduces frizz, deeply nourishes strands, and revives dull hair, leaving a luminous, golden glow that catches every ray of light.
products.howToUse: Apply a small amount to damp hair before styling to lock in moisture, reduce frizz, and enhance smoothness. For added glow and a polished finish, apply a drop or two on dry hair, focusing on mid-lengths and ends. Perfect for daily use or touch-ups whenever your hair needs a boost of shine.
products.ingredients: Jojoba Oil, Argan Oil, Sweet Almond Oil, Avocado Oil, Pro-Vitamin B5, Peptides, Silk Protein, Vitamin E

products.name: Curly Hair Brush
products.shortDescription: Bring your curls to life with our Curly Hair Brush, specially designed to define, detangle, and enhance your natural curl pattern without frizz or breakage.

products.name: Satin Pillow Cover
products.shortDescription:
Sleep Smooth. Wake Beautiful.
Our satin pillow cover is designed to reduce friction on your hair and skin while you sleep, helping to prevent frizz, breakage, and creases. The smooth, silky texture keeps hair moisturized and skin soft, promoting healthier hair and glowing skin every morning. Lightweight and breathable, it’s a luxurious addition to your bedtime routine.
products.howToUse: Slip the satin cover over your pillow and enjoy a gentle, protective surface all night long. Machine washable for easy care.

products.name: Scalp Massager
products.shortDescription:
Stimulate. Relax. Strengthen.
Made with soft silicone, this gentle scalp massager boosts circulation, encourages healthy hair growth, and delivers a calming, spa-like experience. Use with your shampoo for a deep cleanse or pair with AlaraLine Miracle Hair Oil to enhance absorption and nourish your roots.
products.howToUse: Use daily in the morning to boost blood circulation and promote relaxation. It’s perfect to use while shampooing or when applying Miracle Hair Oil.

products.name: Derma Roller 0.25mm
products.shortDescription:
Boost Hair Growth and Improve Skin Texture
This 0.25mm derma roller is designed to gently stimulate the scalp, helping improve circulation and enhance the absorption of hair growth oils. The fine titanium needles create micro-channels that allow nutrients to reach the hair follicles more effectively. It can also be used on the skin to improve tone, texture, and product absorption.
products.howToUse: Disinfect before each use. On clean, dry scalp or skin, roll gently in vertical, horizontal, and diagonal directions using light pressure. Follow with your favorite hair growth oil or skincare product. Use 2–3 times per week.

products.name: Diffuser Top for Hair Dryers
products.shortDescription:
Fits All Hair Dryer Models
This diffuser top easily attaches to any hair dryer. It spreads the airflow gently to reduce frizz and helps define curls and waves, giving your hair more volume and bounce.
products.howToUse: Attach the diffuser to your Secchoire dryer. Place sections of damp hair into the bowl, then dry using low heat and speed. Hold near the roots to add volume or scrunch upwards to define curls.

products.name: Microfiber Hair Towel
products.shortDescription:
Frizz-Free Drying, Fast and Gentle.
Soft and absorbent microfiber dries hair quickly without friction, reducing frizz, breakage, and heat damage for smoother, healthier-looking hair.
products.howToUse: After washing your hair, gently squeeze out excess water. Flip your head forward, place the towel over your head, and wrap it securely. Twist the towel and tuck or fasten it in place. Leave on for 10–20 minutes, then remove and style as usual — no rubbing needed.

products.name: Golden Dusky Tanning Oil
products.shortDescription:
Glow Fast. Tan Deep.
Golden Dusky is a fast-absorbing tanning oil designed to accelerate your natural tan while keeping your skin nourished and protected. It helps you achieve a golden glow in less time, without causing dryness or burns. Lightweight and non-greasy, it leaves your skin soft, smooth, and sun-kissed.
products.howToUse: Apply generously to clean, dry skin before sun exposure. Reapply regularly, especially after swimming or towel-drying. For best results, avoid peak UV hours and tan gradually.
products.ingredients: Sweet Almond Oil, Cocoa Seed Extract, Coconut Oil, Olive Oil, Grape Seed Oil, Green Tea, Walnut Oil, Date Oil, Watermelon Seeds, SPF 15.
